description: This file contains selector functions for accessing and deriving general configuration and state information in a Mattermost Redux store, including feature flags, license info, server version, and feature toggles.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the general configuration object from the global state.

methods.name: getFeatureFlagValue
methods.description: Safely retrieves the value of a specific feature flag from the configuration.

methods.name: getPasswordConfig
methods.description: Creates a password configuration object based on the current state configuration.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Retrieves the license information from the state.

methods.name: isCloudLicense
methods.description: Determines if the current license is a cloud license.

methods.name: isCompatibleWithJoinViewTeamPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the server version is compatible with join view team permissions.

methods.name: canUploadFilesOnMobile
methods.description: Determines if file uploads are enabled on mobile devices.

methods.name: canDownloadFilesOnMobile
methods.description: Determines if file downloads are enabled on mobile devices.

methods.name: getAutolinkedUrlSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of URL schemes for autolinking.

methods.name: getManagedResourcePaths
methods.description: Retrieves managed resource paths from configuration.

methods.name: getServerVersion
methods.description: Returns the server version string.

methods.name: getFirstAdminVisitMarketplaceStatus
methods.description: Checks if the first admin visit to the marketplace has occurred.

methods.name: getFirstAdminSetupComplete
methods.description: Checks if the first admin setup is complete.

methods.name: isPerformanceDebuggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if performance debugging is enabled.

methods.name: isMarketplaceEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the marketplace feature is enabled.

methods.name: getUsersStatusAndProfileFetchingPollInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the polling interval for user status and profile fetching.

methods.name: developerModeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if developer mode is enabled.

methods.name: testingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if testing features are enabled.

methods.name: getCustomProfileAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves custom profile attributes, sorted by sort order.

methods.name: getIsCrossTeamSearchEnabled
methods.description: Checks if cross-team search is enabled.

methods.name: getCWSAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves CWS availability state.
